verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents an AI Linter that checks every page against natural-language style-guide rules. Docs Audit runs those rules across the whole project in one pass. Reviews let changes be checked with the AI Linter in isolated branches before they reach the live hub. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the linter works as claimed, and explicit documentation that lint checks run automatically or block publishing rather than being invoked during review.

support.subject: As a technical writer, automated checks lint my content against a style guide and flag issues before they publish

citations.quote: An AI-powered tool for checking page content against your own style guide.
You write rules in natural language — like "Use active voice" or "Flag placeholder text" — and it checks every page against them
Docs Audit runs your Linter rules against every page in your project in a single pass, so you can find outdated content, broken links, and style inconsistencies across your entire site
Reviews allow you to check your changes for issues with the AI Linter or get approval from a teammate.
Create and review documentation changes in isolation, so nothing reaches your live hub until your team has approved it.
